threads_evidence: One private CPU llama-server pinned to FILLER_CPUS; -t and -tb both use FILLER_THREADS. One synchronous AdaMAST call at a time.
width_justification: One synchronous judge and one CPU llama-server with a width capped by the approved quarter grant.
decision_rule: Describe fixed-catalog MAST code prevalence on a frozen sample of three traces per observed Claude/Codex, month, and main/subagent stratum. Use Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0 on CPU v10 (10303, ffc1bac82), one call per trace, outcome fields stripped, no oracle. Record per-code counts, observed strata, refusals and valid denominators. The pilot has little resolution within a stratum (n<=3) and supports descriptive rates for this sample only. Stop when all traces have terminal receipts. Stop for futility after at least 8 attempted traces with >25% failed receipts; keep the failed receipts and report incomplete coverage. Stop between items at the keeper deadline or stop file. A single real response validated in the isolated smoke qualifies launch. Do not infer faithfulness, confirm the proposed F-series crosswalk, or advance Stage 2 from these grades.
